```powershell
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "/home/author\Documents\GitHub\repo-21\replays"

# Verify space freed
[math]::Round((Get-ChildItem "/home/author\Documents\GitHub\repo-21\replays" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB, 2)
```
